notes.title: Shopping Empire Tycoon : Halloween Level Update
notes.notes:
ENGLİSH :

With This Update;

*Buttons To Adjust Music And Sound Fx Level Have Been Added.

*10 New Unlockable Achievements Have Been Added. The Hardest New Achievement Is To Sell 10.000 Pumpkins.

*Level Selection Panel Has Been Added. Now You Can Start From Any Level You Want.

*Special Halloween Level Gas Been Added (Happy Halloween!)

*6 Quests Are Coming With The New Halloween Level

*Halloween Level Has New Customer Types. Play To Find Out!

*Fullscreen Adaptation For 1920x1080.
